issue: Customer-imported CSV/XLSX records had no way to remove a stale, incorrect or superseded dataset from the current portal.
root_cause: Original importer provided immutable add/history and read-only destination projections but no authenticated source lifecycle operation.
prevention_rule: A source removal must require explicit owner confirmation, exact unique fingerprint+ID match in current authenticated tenant state, original domainState writer flush, independent server readback, and destination projection cleanup. Do not pretend removal erases provider records, backups or audit history.

architecture.proof: stateClient.load with matching owner and remaining source IDs/fingerprints
